sentences.l2: 一家公司用电脑帮助别人工作。
sentences.l1: A company uses computers to help others work.

sentences.l2: 电脑需要学习很多例子才能做好工作。
sentences.l1: Computers need to learn many examples in order to do their work well.

sentences.l2: 这些例子是从用户那里来的。
公司要告诉用户：“我们在用你的数据帮助电脑学习。”
sentences.l1: The company must tell users: "We are using your data to help the computer learn."

sentences.l2: 公司也要说明电脑是怎么做决定的。
sentences.l1: The company also must explain how the computer makes decisions.

sentences.l2: 比如，电脑为什么给这个人发消息？
sentences.l1: For example, why does the computer send this person a message?

sentences.l2: 为什么不让那个人登录？
sentences.l1: Why not let that person log in?
Users have the right to know these things.

sentences.l2: 公司要写清楚的话，放在网上。
sentences.l1: The company must write clear words and put them online.

sentences.l2: 这样，大家才会相信这家公司。
sentences.l1: Only in this way will everyone trust this company.

sentences.l2: 如果公司不说清楚，用户会担心。
sentences.l1: If the company does not explain clearly, users will worry.

sentences.l2: 用户可能不再用这个服务。
sentences.l1: Users may no longer use this service.

sentences.l2: 公司要经常检查自己有没有说清楚。
sentences.l1: The company must often check whether it has explained clearly.

sentences.l2: 也要听用户的建议，改得更好。
sentences.l1: It must also listen to users' suggestions and change to do better.

sentences.l2: 说清楚，才能让别人觉得你很诚实。
sentences.l1: Only by explaining clearly can you make others feel that you are honest.
